svg.title: Category-specific versus category-unified localization paradigms
svg.desc: Two-row comparison figure. Row (a) shows previous category-specific paradigm: separate pedestrian, truck, car, cyclist models; point-point dense interaction using template and search region point clouds; global-pooled localization and point-wise localization with bounding box. Row (b) shows category-unified paradigm: all categories share one model; adaptive keypoint sparse alignment between template and search region; structure-aware localization by graph geometry and bounding box.

g.title: One category one model, with four object-category icons connected to four dedicated models.
Template and search-region point clouds connected by dense red interactions.
Global-pooled localization branch and point-wise localization branch from N point features to scores and bounding box.
All categories connect to one category-unified model.
Template and search-region point clouds with selected diamond keypoints and sparse vertical red alignments.
Sparse structure graph uses orange upper and green lower structure-aware links, then localizes a bounding box on a point-cloud object.
